name: bookipi-flash-sale
description: Root dev orchestration: docker compose (Mongo/Redis) + server + client in one command.

scripts.start:all: docker compose up -d && concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm:start:all:server" "npm:start:all:client"
scripts.demo: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run seed --prefix server -- --state=upcoming --stock=5 --in=45 && npm run start:all
